Gerginlikleri ve bıkkınlıkları, sürekli "hadi bitirin, 4e kadar bitirmek zorundasınız (lab bitiş saati 4 bile değil), sizi bekleyemeyiz, bitirin artık” gibi cümleler kurmaları da ayrı bir stres yaratıyor. The course was helpful in introducing the experimental methods of organic chemistry. However, this course was extremely time consuming, inefficient at teaching, had unclear requirements for reports, did not match the curriculum of Chem-231 and experiments could often not fit into the given time. 
First of all, since the objective of an undergraduate lab is to teach to students that are new to the methods and topics; there should be enough time to complete the experiments in the given time. The need to rush the experiments and to cut corners to finish in time is both dangerous, can create bad habits and leads to incomplete learning. The students are new and should learn the methods right, even if it is slower, and only after this should they speed up the processes. The experiments should be designed to fit into the four hour time frames considering the inexperience of the students and the need to complete the experiments with intention and thinking behind every move, without taking risks.
Another point is that the students are learning to write reports in undergrad lab courses, the instructors should be responsible of teaching the students how to write reports instead of the students experimenting on writing a report by themselves without feedback. Students can certainly learn how to write studying outside sources, but that is true for most things and beside the point. Writing the prelabs and the reports took up more time than all my other courses combined because of how unclear what i was supposed to do was, on top of the known requirements being excessive. And there were no proper feedback that helped me correct and optimize my reports. The topics of the experiments usually did not match what we learned previously at chem-231 and this required excessive studying to comprehend them (i included this studying time in my prior statement about time consumption). Some quizes also did not have enough time for completion. 2000 characters is not enough to adress everything.
